build_problem_simple: build a simple learning-to-learn problem where f(x) = x squared
build_problem_quadratic: build a quadratic learning-to-learn problem with configurable batch size and dimensions
build_problem_mnist: build an MNIST classification problem with a multi-layer perceptron network
build_problem_cifar10: build a CIFAR-10 classification problem with a convolutional neural network
build_problem_ensemble: build an ensemble of learning-to-learn problems with optional weighted losses
